compound.name: oroxylin A
compound.one_liner: 6-Methoxy isomer of wogonin, found in both skullcaps.

occurrences.source_citation: Lin L-Z, Harnly JM, Upton R (2009) Comparison of the phenolic component profiles of skullcap (Scutellaria lateriflora) and germander (Teucrium canadense and T. chamaedrys), a potentially hepatotoxic adulterant. Phytochem Anal 20(4):298-306
occurrences.note: LOTUS LTS0188883 lists S. lateriflora (ref 10.1021/np900068t, as decoded). Lin 2009 identified oroxylin A and oroxylin A 7-O-glucuronide in authenticated aerial parts.

occurrences.source_citation: Cosmetic Ingredient Review Expert Panel (2020) Safety Assessment of Scutellaria baicalensis-Derived Ingredients as Used in Cosmetics, final report 29 Sep 2020 (citing Cai et al. 2016). https://www.cir-safety.org/sites/default/files/scutel092020FR_0.pdf
occurrences.database: Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases
occurrences.note: CIR/Cai 2016: 7.24 mg/g aqueous root extract. Duke also OROXYLIN-A-7-O-GLUCURONIDE Root 1000-41000 ppm. KNApSAcK C00003804. | Basis as recorded: ppm as listed by Duke (basis not stated per row; for 'Essent. Oil' parts it is ppm of the oil, 10000 ppm = 1 %) Basis (fresh/dry weight) not stated by the source; excluded from /compare until confirmed.

compound.teaching_note: Oroxylin A and wogonin differ only in where the methoxy group sits (C6 vs C8).
gaps: No human evidence for the isolated compound found in this pass.
